1. ch32Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0218

Throughout this chapter all $3$-manifolds are orientable. The normalized Ricci flow on a closed $n$-manifold is \begin{equation*} \frac{\partial }{\partial t}g_{ij} =-2R_{ij}+\frac{2}{n}r g_{ij}, \qquad r(t)=\frac{\int _{\mathcal M}R_{g(t)}\, d\mu _{g(t)}}{\int _{\mathcal M}d\mu _{g(t)}}. \tag {32.1} \end{equation*} It preserves volume.
